final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT MIN(a.link_to_event) AS event_id, e.status AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count FROM attendance AS a JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status), step2 AS (SELECT status, SUM(member_count) AS member_count FROM step1 GROUP BY status), step3 AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_count FROM step2) SELECT step2.status, step2.member_count, CAST(step2.member_count AS REAL) / step3.total_count FROM step2 JOIN step3 ON step3.total_count IS NOT NULL
